Apple has just seeded the seventh developer beta of iOS 27. iOS 27 beta 7 continues Apple's testing cycle this summer, with a public release expected in September. We'll be updating our devices and sharing results.

Apple releases seventh iOS 27 developer beta for testing

The seventh developer beta is now available to install from the Settings app on eligible iPhones. If you're signed up for the Apple Developer Program, head to Settings > General > Software Update > Beta Updates and choose the iOS 27 Developer Beta.

The developer beta released today is likely to become the fifth public beta of iOS 27. The final version for all users is due out next month.

As with all beta software, you should still expect bugs, reduced battery life, app compatibility issues, and other rough edges.

All eyes on Siri AI in iOS 27

iOS 27 is one of Apple's most AI-focused iPhone updates ever. The headliner feature is Siri AI, Apple's rebuilt assistant powered by a new generation of Apple Intelligence and the new Apple Foundation Models.

Siri AI delivers richer conversations, personal context, broader world knowledge, on-screen awareness, and the ability to take deeper actions across apps throughout the system.

On iPhone, Siri AI also gets a new visual experience designed to work with the Dynamic Island, along with a dedicated Siri app for revisiting conversations across devices.

Visual intelligence is also coming to Siri, including a new Siri mode inside the Camera app and improvements to iPhone's camera control feature.

Apple Intelligence is also expanding across more apps. iOS 27 brings AI-powered improvements to Photos, Safari, Passwords, Mail, Messages, Phone, Shortcuts, Home, and more. As we noted when breaking down Apple's new Foundation Models, some features will run on-device, while others will use Private Cloud Compute.

More iOS 27 features and changes

Beyond Siri and Apple Intelligence, iOS 27 includes a number of iPhone-specific changes. Apple has refined last year's Liquid Glass design, including adding a new Liquid Glass transparency slider to let users tune the look of the system interface.

App launches, photo loading, camera launch in Low Power Mode, AirDrop transfers, and handoffs between Wi-Fi and cellular have all been improved.

Other iPhone changes include keyword and star ratings for photos, customizable slideshow playback, smoother camera operation, continuous message sending, dual-camera FaceTime recording, custom EQ for AirPods, new recovery options, easier Apple Pay card switching, and AI-generated wallpapers.

We're installing iOS 27 beta 7 now and will update with any noteworthy new findings. In the meantime, you can also catch up on everything new in iOS 27 from our Apple keynote roundup.
